name: Dinosaur Valley
pitch: On a time-hopping field trip, the child is guided by a gentle triceratops and helps a baby dinosaur find its family before the time portal closes.
setting: Fernhollow Valley, long ago: giant ferns, steaming warm springs, a sparkling waterfall, and a quiet volcano that only puffs harmless smoke rings

supportingCast.name: Clover
supportingCast.look: gentle mint-green triceratops with rosy cheeks and a flower tucked behind one frill

supportingCast.name: Peep
supportingCast.look: tiny purple duckbill dinosaur with big curious eyes and a cracked bit of eggshell on its head

supportingCast.name: Professor Tock
supportingCast.look: a cheerful tortoise wearing a pocket watch and a bow tie

contentRules: dinosaurs are friendly, no predators chasing anyone

starters.title: Peep Finds Her Nest
starters.idea: Baby Peep is lost and the time portal closes at sunset. Following the biggest footprints leads to the wrong herd, and calling loudly scares the others away. The child notices Peep hums the same song as a mother dinosaur far away; they follow the song and Peep is home just before the portal closes.

starters.title: Professor Tock's Broken Clock
starters.idea: Professor Tock's time-watch freezes in the age of the dinosaurs. Shaking it and asking a pterodactyl both fail. The child spots that a tiny fern is stuck in the gears, Clover gently blows it free with a sneeze, and everyone gets home, with a footprint fossil as a keepsake.
